newsitem.title: HONG KONG: LAI SUN DEV TO BID FOR FURAMA - SOURCES
newsitem.headline: LAI SUN DEV TO BID FOR FURAMA - SOURCES

text.p: Lai Sun Development Co Ltd is expected to bid for a controlling stake in Furama Hotel Enterprises Ltd at HK$33.50 per share, industry sources said on Thursday.
Sources said Lai Sun was expected to buy a 45.4 percent stake from Furama's controlling shareholder which would result in a general offer for all outstanding Furama shares.

Furama, whose shares were suspended from trade on Wednesday, had said earlier that third parties had approached its 45.42 percent controlling shareholder, Townsend International Ltd, in connection with buying a stake in the firm.
Industry sources said Lai Sun was expected to announce the acquisition plan later on Thursday but no further details were immediately available.
Furama shares rose HK$0.65 to end at HK$26 when last traded on Tuesday.
Trading in the shares of parent company Lai Sun International Ltd, Lai Sun Development and Lai Sun Hotels International Ltd was suspended on Wednesday pending an announcement.
